name: task_selective_conditioning_gain_pp
tolerance_policy: Report paired map-cluster 95% bootstrap intervals and Monte Carlo repeat variability across at least 5 evaluation seeds. Proposed practical band is +/-5 percentage points, requiring owner/advisor approval before freezing; non-significance is not equivalence. No relative-error rule at a near-zero mean.
operational_definition: D=100*mean_base[(V(correct_condition,T)-V(stale_condition,T))-(V(correct_condition,I)-V(stale_condition,I))]. Every V is measured on its own true edited map, includes all requested raw proposals, and uses the same latent bank across conditions. T closes a route while preserving fallback; I edits an inaccessible region with matched occupied-cell change.
aggregation: Average within base-map family over latent/evaluation repeats, then equally across base-map families; bootstrap base families with all paired arms together. Stratify ID-like versus held-out topology layouts descriptively without switching the primary population.
failure_treatment: NaN, endpoint failure, boundary violation, segment collision, truncated trajectory and missing requested proposal are invalid. Report run-level software failures separately; never drop a bad arm or pool only accepted paths. No verifier-selected-path outcome substitutes for D.
secondary_metrics: True-map validity of first verifier-selected path; no accepted path counts as failure
_note: Conditional S0 proposal, not frozen or empirically validated. A signed diagnostic maximized for useful selectivity is not a metric of all planning quality.
